ACT XII OF 2023
PUNJAB PENSION FUND (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Punjab Pension Fund Act, 2007
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 17th February, 2023]
No. PAP/Legis-2(140)/2021/105, dated 17.2.2023.---The Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Bill, 2021,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 9th day of
January 2023, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 23rd day of
January 2023, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
It is necessary to amend the Punjab Pension Fund
Act, 2007 (I of 2007) for the purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab
as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be cited as the Punjab Pension Fund (Amendment) Act, 2023.
(2) This Act
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 15 of Act I of 2007
